mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events(event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, created_at, status, attempts, next_attempt_at) VALUES(#{eventId}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{createdAt}, 'PENDING', 0, #{nextAttemptAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM outbox_events WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'CLAIMED' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY created_at, event_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'CLAIMED', attempts = IF(attempts < 2147483647, attempts + 1, attempts), lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'CLAIMED' AND lease_until <= #{now}))

UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'SENT', published_at = #{publishedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'CLAIMED' AND lease_owner = #{owner}
